description: Lists the savings rows in the person’s Untap account, filtered by category and status. Each row has the verdict status (claimable, pending_check, not_eligible and so on) and user_progress, what the person has recorded since: none, submitted (sent), received (paid) or archived. Requires sign-in to Untap.

category.description: Restrict to a single category, or null for all categories.

limit.description: Maximum number of savings rows to return. Defaults to 25, capped at 100.

status.description: Restrict to a single status, or null for all.

name: list_savings
title: List the person’s refund opportunities
